sloka: तत्रैनां विजने देशे विसृज्य रघुनन्दन ।शीघ्रमागच्छ भद्रं ते कुरुष्व वचनं मम ।। ७.४५.१८ ॥
transliteration: tatraināṁ vijane deśe visṛjya raghunandana ।śīghramāgaccha bhadraṁ te kuruṣva vacanaṁ mama ।। 7.45.18 ॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, having abandoned her there in that solitary place, return quickly; may good fortune be yours, and carry out my command.
